name: Jateen Narsai
description: Meet Solvero founder Jateen Narsai: business and systems analysis, solution design and delivery, informed by 15 years in financial services.
biography: Jateen Narsai is the founder of Solvero, with 15 years of financial services experience across business and systems analysis, solution design and software delivery. He works through complex problems, connects business and technical teams, and carries agreed work from requirements through testing and handover.
